content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am trying to record the IO status of [product_name] in a Microsoft Excel file. Currently, I only receive the IO channel names in a single row (such as i1, i2, i3... q1, q2, q3, etc.), but not the status values themselves. The IO status screen shows the current states, but these values do not appear in the exported Excel CSV file from [product_name]. Could someone advise how to log actual wind turbine data with both channel names and their status values? Best regards, [user_name]
How is the enable input for the data logging feature controlled?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to export IO status from [product_name] hardware into a Microsoft Excel file for logging purposes. However, only IO channel names are present in the exported data, rather than the real-time status values visible on the device screen. This discrepancy is causing confusion about the data logging capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the exported Excel (CSV) file to include both the IO channel names and their corresponding live status values, mirroring what is visible on the IO status screen.
